Alex (PM): quick sync — we need a single, implementable schema for route-level metering that covers: per-route caps, token accounting (input vs output), burst credits, and an opt-in priority class. thinking minimal fields and clear launch criteria.
Maria (Billing): +1. customers keep asking about "separate embedding vs chat pricing" and how credits are applied. need explicit billing_metric.
Ravi (Backend): can you sketch a minimal payload? will help estimate work and db changes.
Alex (PM): sure — proposal below (very small):
```json
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "billing_metric": "tokens|embeddings|calls",
  "token_accounting": "input_only|output_only|both",
  "quota": {
    "limit": 100000,
    "window_seconds": 86400
  },
  "burst_credits": 5000,
  "priority_class": "standard|business|enterprise",
  "metering_labels": ["model_family","region"]
}
```
Maria (Billing): prefer explicit names: billing_metric should allow: "input_tokens", "output_tokens", "embedding_units". Also need a field for "billing_unit_price" (sentimental for quotes/preview).
Alex (PM): ok add billing_unit_price optional, but please note pricing engine stays separate. aim is to expose the accounting primitives, not full price calc.
Ravi (Backend): implementation notes:
- token_accounting needs to map to tokenizer model variant. we must surface which tokenizer to use per route (or default to model.tokenizer).
- both option means charge input+output; watch double-count for cached KV prefix hits.
Chen (Infra): infra concerns:
- per-route counters meaning more cardinality in Redis/TSDB. suggest we support aggregated buckets (route+day) and an approximate counter for burst window.
- fallback policy: if quota DB unreachable, we should default to "allow" for enterprise and "throttle" for standard. need config knob.
Tanya (EngOps): launch criteria proposal:
1) API contract reviewed by product + billing (this thread)
2) backend PoC with sample route + e2e token counting (include KV cache cases)
3) infra stress test at 10x expected cardinality
4) non-regression for streaming latency (<50ms added p99)
5) docs + quickstart + console UI stub for per-route quotas
Maria (Billing): also require billing reconciliation job for first 30 days (compare expected charges vs actual). add as prelaunch item.
Ravi (Backend): rough effort: PoC 2w, infra work 1w, API changes + rollout flags 1w. can parallelize.
Alex (PM): decision points for scope negotiation:
- MVP: token_accounting supports "input_only|both"; output_only later (lower priority).
- MVP: billing_metric values -> "tokens" and "embeddings" only. "calls" and fine-grain units later.
- MVP: priority_class support limited to routing; bill-tier behavior later.
Maria (Billing): okay, ensure delta for enterprise customers (billing previews) is included in contract work.
Chen (Infra): will prototype approximate counters in a feature branch and share perf numbers by EOD Fri.
quota-bot: created ticket #INF-4123 with PoC checklist and linked this thread. :white_check_mark:
Alex (PM): action items:
- Ravi: spin PoC and push schema PR (week1)
- Chen: prototype counters + fallback policy (week1)
- Maria: define billing_metric canonical values and reconciliation job (this sprint)
- Tanya: write launch checklist and own docs/console items (this sprint)
Any objections to MVP scope above? :eyes:
